main.description: Validate that a sender has completed item payment(s) to the authenticated user (as the recipient/subject). Looks up by itemUri (a specific item record), recordUri (sums all items for that record), or sender (sender DID). These are mutually exclusive and resolved in that order.

itemUri.description: AT-URI of a specific item record. Takes precedence over recordUri and sender.

recordUri.description: AT-URI of the record being tipped. Takes precedence over sender.

sender.description: DID of the item sender. Ignored if itemUri or recordUri is provided.

amount.description: Expected item amount in cents. If omitted, only checks that a item exists.

valid.description: Whether a sender has completed and verified item(s) to the authed recipient

amount.description: Sum of all verified completed item amounts in cents
